verdict.rationale: Pandoc is a document conversion CLI and library, and a tool of this kind could plausibly ship an AI assistant, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows any built-in AI assistant or task-delegation feature. The documented filters, Lua readers/writers and server mode are customization and building-block features, not an assistant, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
